Chapter 7064: You Can’T Imagine What I Had Let Go

Chapter 7064: You Can’t Imagine What I Had Let Go

“We shall kill you first.” Heaven’s Demise blocked Li Qiye’s path.

The other celestial immortals surrounded Li Qiye.

“It’s starting.” Spectators watched with bated breath.

Other cultivators in the ocean retreated since they weren’t qualified to participate. However, they seemed to be forming a momentum to prevent Li Qiye’s escape.

“Four against one.” One spectator said.

Among the four celestial immortals, Heaven’s Demise and Dragongrasp possessed paramita bodies. Nonetheless, Zhao Dachui and Heaven’s Slayer could still obliterate any of them.

“I wonder what they can do.” An immortal commented.

“This isn’t quite at Heaven Pit level, but that should be a good starting point for comparison.” A golden immortal said.

Currently, Dusk and Heavenfall are missing, not to mention the more mysterious Hidden Immortal and Octopus.

“Can Li Qiye handle this?” Someone asked.

“Maybe it’s an easy sweep. After all, he has let go.” A golden immortal whispered.

“Just the four of you? Go ahead and open the heaven-slaying grand momentum.” Li Qiye said.

“When the time comes, no need to be anxious.” Heaven’s Slayer said.

“Let’s not waste everyone’s time by delaying it. The four of you can’t amount to anything.” Li Qiye said sincerely.

The fight had yet to start but Li Qiye already looked down on them. This was certainly a new feeling for the four.

“I want to see the extent you have let go.” Heaven’s Demise uttered coldly.

“It is beyond your imagination.” Li Qiye smiled.

“What is the highest level?” Heaven’s Demise couldn’t help but ask.

Hidden Immortal and Octopus have never discussed their cultivation. They also never had the chance to meet An Ran, hence their interest in the next stage.

“Haven’t you met Hidden Immortal and Octopus?” Li Qiye asked: “Hahaha, looks like they never trusted you all. The two of you are from Heaven Essence Alliance while you, dragon, must be related to Hidden Immortal. They never gave you hints for the next stage, definitely on guard.”

Listeners exchanged glances and agreed with this assessment. The first two have done so much for Heaven Essence Alliance in Octopus’ absence. As for Dragongrasp, the potential leader of Immortal Hunt, he must have been in Hidden Immortal’s grace.

Meanwhile, Zhao Dachui thought that they were lucky that their lord, Mang, wasn’t at the highest stage. Mang never hid anything from the juniors and taught them everything. It appeared Mang was indeed a great leader compared to these top celestial immortals.

“No need to try to sow division.” Dragongrasp uttered.

“That’s fine, we can move to a different topic while you all can still speak.” Li Qiye smiled.

“We have nothing to discuss.” Heaven’s Demise disagreed.
